The upright flame flickers subtly in height and width while remaining centered above the wick.
Polished metallic side walls cast duplicate reflections that track the central vessel's shifting glow.
Slight handheld jitter nudges the framing throughout the excerpt without deliberate panning or zooming.
caption: The video captures a single frosted-glass votive candle holder seated at the center of a polished metallic enclosure. A small upright flame burns above the wick, keeping the upper rim pale while the lower half glows from within. Mirrored side walls cast two duplicate images of the vessel, each with a bright flame reflection, and a perforated metal panel stands behind the holder. Throughout the excerpt the internal glow drifts, starting as a uniform green that fills the base and both side reflections. As the frames advance the green cools toward cyan and then blue, the left side and its reflection shifting first while the right lingers in green. By the final frames the central vessel and left wall read blue, the right still holding a teal cast. The flame flickers subtly, its height and width varying from frame to frame yet staying centered and lit. Slight handheld jitter nudges the framing, with no deliberate pan or zoom. The mirrored reflections track the same hue change as the central object, echoing the shifting glow rather than acting as separate lights.
